top_signals.title: US Futures Drop as Focus Turns on Chipmaker Earnings, Inflation
top_signals.summary: US stock futures are lower during the premarket session on Monday as investors gear up for the final stretch of earnings. Earnings this week from chipmakers could provide confirmation for the long-winded debate over chip valuations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Japan’s 2026 defense white paper highlights ‘new era of crisis’ in Indo-Pacific
top_signals.summary: Japan’s 2026 Defense White Paper called China the world's “greatest strategic challenge,” citing Beijing’s expanded cooperation with Moscow.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
